name: io.nerochain/docs
description: MCP server for NERO Chain documentation — a Layer-1 blockchain with native account abstraction (ERC-4337), paymaster-based gas sponsorship, and Web2-style authentication. Seven tools covering search, page retrieval, Paymaster JSON-RPC method lookup, curated code examples, FAQ, and structured integration configuration. 143 docs:// resources (EN + JA) plus four ui:// MCP Apps templates.
author: NERO Chain

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Full-text BM25 search across NERO Chain documentation pages (EN + JA). Returns ranked hits with URL, title, section, summary.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Fetch full markdown of a NERO docs page by URL path.

tools.name: list_sections
tools.description: Return navigation tree of NERO Chain docs.

tools.name: get_api_method
tools.description: Return signature + examples for a Paymaster JSON-RPC method (pm_supported_tokens, pm_sponsor_userop, pm_entrypoints).

tools.name: get_code_example
tools.description: Return curated NERO integration snippet for 21 topics: quickstart, providers-setup, wallet-hook, builder-with-paymaster-hook, send-gasless-tx, send-userop, batch-transactions, erc20-transfer, nft-mint, staking, integrate-aa-wallet, web3auth-login-methods, nextjs-ssr-setup, fetch-balance, fetch-price, check-supported-tokens, complete-wallet-component, line-miniapp, error-handling, deploy-contract-hardhat, deploy-contract-remix.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Return NERO Chain FAQ entries, optionally filtered by topic.

tools.name: get_integration_config
tools.description: Structured JSON reference for NERO Chain integration: networks (testnet/mainnet), contracts (EntryPoint, SimpleAccountFactory, staking), paymaster payment types, env vars, Web3Auth setup, security rules.

resources.name: NERO Docs — search results view
resources.description: Compact HTML list of search hits for rendering inline in an MCP-Apps-capable chat UI.

resources.name: NERO Docs — page preview
resources.description: Preview panel for a single doc page (title, section, summary, link, truncated markdown).

resources.name: NERO Docs — API method card
resources.description: Reference card for a Paymaster JSON-RPC method: signature, params, return shape, docs link.

resources.name: NERO Docs — embed
resources.description: Shell that links to the AI resources hub. Used when no specific UI applies.

resourceTemplates.name: NERO docs page
resourceTemplates.description: Full markdown of any NERO docs page. locale ∈ {en, ja}. 143 resources total.
